name: Financial Assistance under Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, an ex-gratia of ₹4,00,000/-  is provided to the legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death and ₹2,00,000/- in case of permanent incapacitation.
_eligibility_text:
1. Journalist should be working in Odisha.
   1. The Journalist should be working for a media house registered with the I&amp;PR department, Odisha.
   1. The applicant should be a legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death or in case of permanent incapacitation.

**Note:** &quot;Permanent Incapacitation&quot; means incapacitation on account of accident, disease, or any other reason which renders the working Journalist wholly unfit for working as such.
